subject: Data retention exception for FinSecure  follow-up
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Asha Gupta <asha@finsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Data retention exception for FinSecure 0 follow-up

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

1) Recap of requirements you called out:
   - PII in request payloads must not be stored persistently (FinSecure: 0-retention for PII).
   - Non-PII telemetry/logs: FinSecure prefers shortened logs (7 days) for debugging only.
   - Need strong audit/logging controls and KMS-managed keys for customer data.
   - Preferred deployment: private VPC or dedicated capacity if 0-retention can't be guaranteed on hosted plan.

2) What Redwood can do today / options:
   - Hosted API + request-side redaction hooks (we can integrate a pre-ingest filter) to avoid persisting PII.
   - Dedicated/Private deployment options that provide stronger guarantees and KMS/HSM integrations.
   - Custom retention schedules (e.g., 0 days for PII, 7 days for non-PII logs) through policy config on Dedicated/Private.

3) Asks from FinSecure to proceed:
   - Confirm whether 0-retention must apply to embeddings and KV cache (we can make these ephemeral in Private).
   - Share the security questionnaire and any DPA/contract redlines (we'll loop legal).
   - If acceptable, we propose a short mutual action plan (MAP) to scope technical work and timelines.

I've attached our high-level retention options and a draft MAP. Next steps I suggest:
   - You confirm the embedding/KV requirement by EOD Monday (2/23).
   - We schedule a 30-min technical deep dive with Rafael to go over ingestion/redaction and logging controls.
   - If MAP looks OK, we'll get Legal (Marissa) to draft DPA language for the retention exception.

Happy to adjust  Rafael and I are available Mon/Tue mornings PST for the deep dive.

Best,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_data_retention_options.pdf, proposed_MAP.xlsx

From: Asha Gupta <asha@finsecure.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: FinSecure Security Team <security@finsecure.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data retention exception for FinSecure 0 follow-up

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: 0-retention requirement applies to any content-derived artifacts that contain PII, including message text and user identifiers.
- Embeddings: We treat embeddings as potential derivative data and would require they be non-persistent or encrypted and deleted immediately after response. Embeddings retention = 0 for PII-derived vectors.
- KV cache: ephemeral only — must not be persisted to long-term storage.
- Non-PII telemetry: 7 days retention is acceptable, strictly for debugging; logs must be access-audited.

I've attached our security questionnaire (FinSecure_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf) and highlighted sections about retention/KMS. Our procurement/legal team will need to see DPA language that explicitly states the retention exception and control commitments.

Looking at options you listed, Private deployment is our preference if it minimizes engineering lift on our side and gives us stronger guarantees. We're happy to do the technical deep dive with Rafael.

Proposed next steps from FinSecure:
 - Technical deep dive with Rafael this week (Tue/Wed preferred).
 - We'll send initial procurement requirements to your legal team after the deep dive.

Thanks —

Asha Gupta
Head of Security & Compliance | FinSecure
asha@finsecure.com | +1 (212) 555-0133

Attachment: FinSecure_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Asha Gupta <asha@finsecure.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data retention exception for FinSecure 0 0 technical deep dive options

Hi Asha —

Happy to run the deep dive. Quick technical notes so the meeting is productive: 

- Embeddings/KV: We can operate with an ephemeral KV cache for the session and avoid writing to durable storage. For embeddings, we support an option to compute and use embeddings purely in-memory and truncate after response.
- Redaction pipeline: we can insert an ingestion hook (serverless or sidecar) to strip/transform PII before it reaches any downstream cache or logging buffer.
- Logging: access to debug logs is via RBAC + audit trails; logs can be configured to drop content fields and retain only metadata for 7 days. We'll include cryptographic key handling under customer KMS for Private deployments.

I've put a first-pass MAP in the attached spreadsheet that maps tasks to owners and estimates (see proposed_MAP.xlsx). For the deep dive, Rafael recommended attendees: Rafael (me), Camila (AE), and one of your platform engineers. 

Available slots: Tue 24 Feb 10:00 11:00 PST or Wed 25 Feb 09:00 10:00 PST. Please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite.

Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Gupta <asha@finsecure.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data retention exception for FinSecure 0 0 legal / procurement notes

Hi Asha —

Thanks for sending the questionnaire — helpful. A few legal notes so procurement has visibility into the impact of the retention exception: 

1) DPA language: we can draft a DPA addendum specifying the custom retention schedule (0 days for PII-derived artifacts; 7 days for non-PII telemetry). We will include definitions for PII, retention triggers, and deletion artifacts.
2) Logging & audit: we will include an audit trail commitment for any access to debug logs (who/when/why) and will provide log-delivery options for a limited window as agreed.
3) Pricing and scope: custom retention + Private deployment and KMS support will change the implementation scope and has cost implications — we'll surface an estimate in the MAP.
4) SOC2/DOCS: I can provide SOC2 summary and the DPA draft for your procurement after the technical deep dive.

Camila — please mark Legal as next step owner for DPA. Asha — once we confirm the technical approach (deep dive), we'll send a short MSA addendum and DPA draft for review.

Regards,

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: DPA_Draft_Redwood_v1.docx

From: Asha Gupta <asha@finsecure.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data retention exception for FinSecure 0 0 confirm next steps

Thanks everyone —

We reviewed internally and FinSecure prefers Private deployment with the following commitments as a go-forward: 
 - 0-retention for PII-derived content (including embeddings)
 - Ephemeral KV cache, no durable writes (confirmed)
 - 7-day non-PII telemetry retention with RBAC/audit access

We'd like to proceed with the technical deep dive on Tue 24 Feb 10:00 PST (slot accepted) and then have your legal team send the DPA addendum draft within 3 business days after that call. Procurement expects a high-level cost delta for Private + custom retention to evaluate vendor selection.

Attendees for the deep dive from our side: Asha Gupta (me), Jorge Ramos (platform engineer, jorge@finsecure.com). Please send the invite and the MAP/estimates beforehand.

Best,

Asha Gupta
Head of Security & Compliance | FinSecure
asha@finsecure.com
